turns.text: I gave the workshop agent a tiny project queue, and before you make that face, I did not let it reorganize the entire workshop.
Your use of the word “tiny” is encouraging. What did you ask it to do?
Nothing clever. Just arrange a few projects. Then I want to see whether it can tell us why it picked that order.
A reasonable question, considering it previously began moving your projects around without explaining its criteria.
Exactly. Maybe it has a brilliant system. Maybe it thinks the 3D printer is emotionally attached to one of them. I am open to both outcomes.
You are more open to the second outcome than evidence currently supports.
The first run, it rearranged the queue. So far, normal enough. Then I asked what changed, and it had no useful explanation.
Then the ordering may be happening without a reason we can inspect. That is not the same as having a good reason.
Which is why I am not handing it the whole project shelf. We run the little queue again, change one thing at a time, and see whether its choices stay sensible.
Good. If it cannot explain the queue, it does not get custody of the workshop. The 3D printer has suffered enough.
